# Review Regeneration Campaign — risk-ordered
**Why:** all 24 published reviews were generated by the pre-audit pipeline. Every review below the confirmed tier (23 of 24) currently serves the hardcoded "you have been targeted by an organized fraud operation" copy and false "FCA/SEC/ASIC/CySEC: None" badges — live defamation exposure. Regeneration also fixes stale threat scores baked into titles, adds Ratings at a Glance, comparables, AI disclosure, and clears the known content bugs.

**Per-review workflow (~10-15 min each, supervised):**
1. Open the review in the editor → **AI Generate** (regenerates on the new stack; auto-demotes to draft)
2. **Polish** (visuals + GPT-5.4 audit + evidence)
3. Review the draft → **Publish** (gates now enforce everything)
4. Live page check: hedged copy, real regulator badges, disclosure box present

Priority = search visibility (28d GSC impressions) × tier mismatch severity × known bugs.

## Special cases

- **affitto-casa-immobiliare** (low, 6/100): Italian REAL-ESTATE brand — was already flagged for UNPUBLISH in the old Phase-4 pending list. Recommend **unpublish, don't regen**: a real-estate advertiser framed inside a crypto-scam review site is the single most defamation-exposed page you have.
- **quantum-ai** (confirmed, 94/100): copy was legitimate — no urgency. Regen last, for the upgrades (sub-scores, comparables, disclosure, 90→94 title fix, and clears the old Stage-4/celebrity issues noted in June).

## Recommended sequence
1. **Pilot: justo-credovia** (fresh brand, already public, lowest stakes) — validates the new stack end-to-end.
2. If clean → Batch 1 (6 reviews), then Batch 2 (5), Batch 3 as background work.
3. **Unpublish affitto-casa-immobiliare today** — one click, removes the worst page.
4. After the pilot renders its disclosure box → flip the Vercel gate to blocking.

Cost estimate: ~24 regens × full pipeline ≈ moderate token spend; spread over days if preferred. Each regen keeps the live page serving until re-publish, so there's no downtime.
